sources.title: LFM2.5-230M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-230M is Liquid AI's smallest LFM2.5 text model, designed for edge devices with the tightest memory and compute budgets. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture, it is tuned for data extraction and lightweight on-device agentic tasks such as tool calling.
